_note: Domestic natural-gas tariff for SNGPL and SSGC (sale prices are notified nationally, so both companies share it). In force since 1 Jul 2025 and kept unchanged for FY2026-27. Rates are per MMBtu; slab boundaries are monthly volume in hm3 (100 cubic metres). verified=false marks figures confirmed only by secondary sources.

sources.title: SSGC: Domestic consumers sale prices and minimum charges (effective 1 Jul 2025, OGRA notification of 29 Jun 2025)
The News: fixed gas charges raised by 50% for domestic consumers from 1 Jul 2025 (Rs 600 / 1,500 / 3,000)
Profit, 7 Jul 2026: government keeps gas tariffs unchanged despite OGRA cut in prescribed prices
Geo, 28 Aug 2026: current 12-slab structure (protected Rs 200-350, non-protected Rs 500-4,200, Rs 40 meter rent); uniform-rate proposal pending
Printed SNGPL bill (Dec 2024): MMBTU = HM3 x GCV / 281.7385, e.g. 0.529 hm3 at GCV 1037 = 1.946 MMBTU
Toolsfluent worked examples (secondary): 18% GST on gas charges + fixed charge + meter rent; ~3.5 MMBTU per hm3

protected_rule_en: Protected if your average use over November to February was 0.9 hm3 a month or less.
protected_rule_ur: اگر نومبر سے فروری تک آپ کا اوسط استعمال 0.9 hm3 ماہانہ یا کم تھا تو آپ محفوظ صارف ہیں۔

previous_slab_benefit._note: Units up to the previous slab's limit are billed at that slab's rate, the rest at the current slab's rate. Not in the top slab (above 4 hm3), where the whole month is billed at Rs 4,200.

conversion._note: MMBTU = hm3 x GCV / 281.7385. GCV is printed on every bill and varies by pipeline; 986 gives about 3.5 MMBTU per hm3.
